response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems software engineer with genuine breadth (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems) and leadership/mentoring activities (workshops, talks), but his profile does not match the core requirement of 8 years of C++ programming or 5 years building large-scale cloud infrastructure/compute platforms. His career is dominated by JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, with only brief, early C++ exposure (National Instruments, ~6 months) and no evidence of cloud compute platform architecture or leading cloud/DevOps teams.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across many stacks and problem domains
Demonstrated mentoring and teaching via workshops, talks, and open-source leadership
Experience with distributed, high-throughput systems (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic micro-services)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No demonstrated experience with cloud compute platforms, large-scale infrastructure, or hardware architecture at the required depth
No formal technical leadership title managing cloud/DevOps engineers or owning platform strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform/infrastructure experience
